basic_info.description: Major Price Improvement! Beautiful Infinity Signature 2BR home with panoramic Downtown San Francisco views and designer finishes. This full service home features hand-scraped truffle maple Robina flooring, Studio Becker kitchen cabinetry, Bosch and Thermador appliances, custom Hunter Douglas window treatments throughout and floor-to-ceiling linen drapes in the bedrooms, custom California Closets, a den area that can be hidden with a sliding door, and more. A private balcony, in-unit washer/dryer, and secure garage parking space complete the home.    International Superstar Architect Bernardo Fort-Brescia of Arquitectonica and local powerhouse Heller Manus have created the quintessential living experience along San Francisco's waterfront complete with a full suite of luxury amenities. Amenities include 24 hr doorman & concierge, club room, 5000SF gym, 75-foot lap pool, theatre room, business center and more. This home is a pleasant walk to Union Square, world class waterfront restaurants, and the Financial District. Easy access to public transportation, 101, 280, 80, and the Bay Bridge.
